source.note: er.md Units and contexts, Comment regions inside names: the line after the region is a segment of its own for the line rule, without the `classDef` before the U+2028, so the `;` of `d fill:#f00;` is not ignored and `#f00;` is read as an entity; the class `c`, U+2028, and `d` has the style with the placeholder of `#f00;`.
